data.one_liner: Provides implementations of TextInputFormatter to format input with pre-defined patterns.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-defined TextInputFormatter implementations for Flutter TextFields. It supports formatting for thousands grouping in integer and decimal numbers, credit card number grouping, and date formatting.
use_when: You need to format numeric text inputs with thousands separators or decimals.
You need to format credit card numbers automatically as the user types.
You need to format date inputs using predefined patterns.
avoid_when: You require complex custom masks that fall outside of the provided pattern implementations.
strengths: Simple to use directly inside standard TextField inputFormatters.
Supports thousands grouping, decimal fractions, credit cards, and dates out of the box.
weaknesses: Limited to the pre-defined patterns provided by the package.

alternatives.name: currency_text_input_formatter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you specifically need localized currency input formatting.
